messages.content: Hi, my BP meds are running out and my pharmacy is 45 minutes away. Can you guys refill it for me?
I can't process refills—that's between you, your doctor, and pharmacy. But I can escalate to a nurse who coordinates with prescribers. Median response time right now is 31 hours.
Ugh ok yeah, escalate me. My reading this morning was 152/88 btw.
Got it—logging that 152/88 and escalating to a nurse for refill coordination now. They'll reach out to you directly.
Thanks. Hoping it's quicker than 31 hours—I go back to work Monday and need it filled by then.
Understood. Flagging your timeline for the nurse. Next check-in scheduled for next week. They'll get this moving for you.
